description: Fits a two-parameter logistic (2PL) IRT model to item-response data. Returns item difficulty and discrimination parameters, person ability estimates (theta), and item information functions. For exam validation, adaptive testing calibration, and bias detection (DIF).

item_columns.description: Binary response columns (0/1) — one per assessment item

ability_prior.description: Prior distribution for ability estimates (default: normal(0,1))
